background: Citibank, N.A. is the main operating bank of Citigroup, with the broadest international network of any US bank, serving multinationals, institutions and consumers across around a hundred countries.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+, one on a positive outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is strong against US banks, with CET1 of 13.8% above the peer median and Tier 1 leverage of 7.9% in the top quarter. LCR of 113% sits at the median. The one move to note is Tier 1 leverage, down 1.1 points since 30 Jun 2025, while CET1 and LCR have held flat.
